text:
Maya: Heads-up — finalizing a 'Voice of Customer' casepack with Jules at ThermaTech. Need legal sign-off, a final customer quote, and asset handoff. Target publish: Mon Apr 22. Quick check-ins below.

Jules (ThermaTech): Thanks Maya — happy to do the interview. I'm free next Tue or Thu morning.

Maya: Perfect. Evan + Noah, can you own metrics and hero assets respectively? Evan for funnel numbers, Noah for visuals/video promo.

Evan: I'll pull product metrics and conversion deltas. ETA EOD today.

Noah: I'll mock 3 hero images and a 30s clip for promo. Need the final logo file from Jules.

Jules (ThermaTech): Uploading logo here: https://thermatech.example/logo.svg (internal). Also ok with this draft quote if legal approves: "Redwood cut our inference cost 3x while improving latency."

Liam: @Maya @Jules I'll take legal on the quote. Two quick asks: (1) change '3x' to 'about 3x' or provide an exact baseline, (2) confirm that any numbers aren't under NDA. Also we'll need a company signatory on the release.

Jules (ThermaTech): We can confirm baseline numbers are public. Signatory will be our VP Ops, Claire H.

Maya: Great — Claire, can you sign the release when it's ready? Draft here (internal): https://drive.redwood/casepack/1716791123-draft — please don't share externally.

Liam: I added redlines: small wording tweaks and an embargo date. Suggest we standardize attribution as: [Name, Title, Company].

Claire (ThermaTech): Happy to sign. Email me the final PDF and I'll route for signature.

Maya: Scheduler for interview — using Zoom. Options (pick one):
```
Tue Apr 9 09:30am PT
Thu Apr 11 10:00am PT
```
@Jules which works?

Jules (ThermaTech): Thu Apr 11 10:00am PT works for me.

Evan: For the metrics, should I reference Q4->Q1 percent changes or absolute numbers?

Jules (ThermaTech): Percent changes only. No absolute raw data.

Liam: Approved language for the quote after edits. New wording: "ThermaTech reduced inference cost by about 3x and improved tail latency," (no raw ms cited). @Maya please update the draft.

Maya: :thumbsup: Updated the doc and uploaded the PDF to the draft link. Claire, sent for signature via DocuSign. Once signed, can we target embargo lift Mon Apr 22 for blog + webinar registration to go live same day?

Claire (ThermaTech): Signed and returned via DocuSign. Good to publish Apr 22.

Sofia: Routing note — inbound leads from the blog should go to the enterprise leads queue, tagged with `casepack-ThermaTech`. Notify AE Sam for priority follow-up.

Sam: Got it — I'll priority-route those leads and use the standard meeting-template for intro calls.

Noah: Final assets will land in drive:/marketing/assets/thermatech/ by EOD Friday (hero images, 30s clip, logo variants).

Maya: Thanks team — last checkpoints: legal ✅, assets being collected, interview scheduled, publish date confirmed. I'll post a final publish checklist tomorrow. :sparkles:

Evan: Adding one more: can we include a short webinar with Jules + product PM as cross-promo? 20–30 minute panel, collect registrants via the blog CTA.

Maya: Love that — let's sync on speaker list and draft slide deck after the interview.

Liam: One legal addendum — please ensure the slide deck doesn't include customer revenue numbers or internal forecasts. Keep to high-level impact statements.

Jules (ThermaTech): Understood. We'll keep it high level. Looking forward to the interview.

Maya: All right — thread action items summarized: 1) Evan: metrics snapshot (percent changes) 2) Noah: assets folder + hero/video 3) Liam: legal redlines applied (done) 4) Claire: signed release (done) 5) Sam: inbound routing and AE follow-up 6) Maya: finalize publish checklist and webinar plan.

Maya: If anyone hits blockers ping me here, otherwise I'll close this thread once the publish checklist is live. Thanks everyone! :partyparrot:
